newsitem.title: UK: Scapa rises after full-year results.
newsitem.headline: Scapa rises after full-year results.

text.p: Shares in paper manufacturer Scapa Group Plc jumped on Thursday after reporting full year pre-tax profits at the top end of the range of analysts forecasts, dealers said.
Scapa shares climbed 10p to 208-1/2p by 0836 GMT in light volume of 33,000 shares.
"The currency hit was not as bad as people were expecting and sentiment is good," said one dealer.

Scapa, which makes specialist fabrics and textiles for the paper and board industries, said pre-tax profits rose to 66.5 milllion stg in the year to March 31 from 62.3 million stg the previous year. Analyst forecasts were in a narrow range of 65 to 66 million stg.
"I think the year ahead could be difficult because of the impact of sterling strength, but the underlying performance looks pretty much underpinned," said one analayst.
